title: IIHF World Championship
metaDescription: IIHF World Championship 2027: dates, host cities Düsseldorf and Mannheim, format, all-time title leaders and recent champions.
venue: PSD Bank Dome and SAP Arena

cities.name: Düsseldorf
cities.airport: Düsseldorf Airport (DUS), about 15 minutes from the centre by S-Bahn.
cities.airportTransfer: The S-Bahn (S11) and regional trains link DUS to Düsseldorf Hauptbahnhof; trams continue to the PSD Bank Dome.
cities.stayGuidance: Stay in Altstadt or Stadtmitte for a short tram ride to the PSD Bank Dome and Düsseldorf's Rhine-side nightlife.
cities.transportTip: Use Düsseldorf's Rheinbahn tram/U-Bahn network; match tickets usually include local travel on game day.
cities.transportDetail: Tram lines run to the arena district; allow extra time on big-match evenings.
cities.eventDayTip: Doors open around 90 minutes before face-off — arrive early for security.
cities.eventDayDetail: Bags are restricted; carry your ticket on your phone and expect queues for marquee games.

cities.name: Mannheim
cities.airport: Frankfurt Airport (FRA) is closest, roughly 1 hour by ICE train to Mannheim.
cities.airportTransfer: Frequent ICE trains run Frankfurt Airport to Mannheim Hauptbahnhof; a tram links the station to SAP Arena.
cities.stayGuidance: Base near Mannheim Hauptbahnhof or the central Quadrate for a direct tram to SAP Arena; Heidelberg is a scenic 15-minute train ride away.
cities.transportTip: Mannheim's RNV tram network serves SAP Arena directly; match tickets usually include local travel.
cities.transportDetail: Tram lines run to the SAP Arena stop, which also serves Adler Mannheim games, so routes are well signposted.
cities.eventDayTip: Arrive early — SAP Arena security opens roughly 90 minutes before face-off.
cities.eventDayDetail: Bag limits apply; keep your ticket accessible and allow time at entry on sold-out nights.

overview.about: The IIHF World Championship is ice hockey's biggest annual national-team event — the 'Worlds' — staged every May by the International Ice Hockey Federation. Sixteen top-division nations play a two-and-a-half-week group stage before quarter-finals and a single-game final. Because it overlaps the NHL playoffs, each country's line-up shifts around which stars are free, which keeps the title unpredictable: five different nations have won the last five tournaments. It is a national obsession across the hockey heartlands of Canada, Finland, Sweden, Czechia and Russia, pulling huge home TV audiences and record crowds — the 2015 edition in the Czech Republic drew an all-time high of more than 740,000 spectators.
overview.nextEvent: The 2027 Worlds return to Germany from 14–30 May, co-hosted across two arenas: PSD Bank Dome in Düsseldorf and SAP Arena in Mannheim. Germany last hosted in 2010 and reached the final on home ice in 2023, while Finland arrive as defending champions after their 2026 title.

location.name: PSD Bank Dome and SAP Arena

airport: Düsseldorf Airport (DUS) serves the Düsseldorf games; Frankfurt (FRA) is closest for the Mannheim venue.
airportTransfer: From DUS the S-Bahn reaches Düsseldorf centre in about 15 minutes; both arenas are on the tram/S-Bahn network.
stayGuidance: Base yourself in central Düsseldorf (Altstadt or Stadtmitte) for the PSD Bank Dome games; for Mannheim matches, stay near Mannheim Hauptbahnhof close to SAP Arena.
transportTip: Both host cities have dense tram/S-Bahn networks and an ICE rail link between them (about 1h40).
transportDetail: Match tickets typically include local public-transport travel on game day; check the tournament transport pass details.
eventDayTip: Doors open around 90 minutes before face-off — arrive early for security at PSD Bank Dome or SAP Arena.
eventDayDetail: Bags are restricted at both arenas; carry your ticket on phone and allow time for entry queues on big-match nights.
